title: Conversation
description: One practice or live conversation round, bundled into a single file. Wraps the transcript plus the per-round intelligence artifacts (premortem, debrief, aftermath, optional emotion results). Persisted at data/local/conversations/<round_id>.json by the Step 13 storage layer. Storage is local-only; nothing is synced.

round_id.description: Stable id for this round. Matches the round_id surfaced in pulse.round_summaries[].round_id when the round is later rolled into a pulse. Filename-safe (alnum, '_', '.', '-').

person_id.description: Optional FK to PersonVault.person_id. Present for practice rounds against a known counterparty; absent for free-form drafts.

person_name.description: Optional display name copied from the matching PersonVault.name.

started_at.description: ISO-8601 timestamp of when this round started. Used as the cross-round sort key (most-recent first) in pulse.round_summaries and the frontend round picker.

mode.description: How the round was conducted. 'practice' is an adversarial persona-sim round (Step 07's emit shape: speaker == 'persona' + reply); 'live' is a transcribed real conversation (Step 03's emit shape: speaker == 'other' + text). The storage layer does NOT normalise the transcript shape — downstream consumers (Steps 06 vs 09/10/11) read what they need.

user_goal.description: Optional. The goal the user set for this round; same string passed to /premortem and /debrief.

transcript.description: Round transcript, verbatim from the consumer that produced it. Storage does NOT canonicalise the shape — practice rounds carry 'persona'/'reply' entries; live rounds carry 'other'/'text' entries.

premortem.description: Optional Step 08 output for this round (the pre-round failure scenarios). Validated by data/schemas/premortem.schema.json. Absent for live rounds that skipped the pre-mortem.

debrief.description: Optional Step 09 output for this round. Validated by data/schemas/debrief.schema.json.

aftermath.description: Optional Step 10 output for this round (plan-vs-reality comparison). Requires premortem to have run; validated by data/schemas/aftermath.schema.json.

emotion_results.description: Optional Step 04 outputs for Live-mode rounds. One entry per analysed chunk; validated against data/schemas/emotion_radar.schema.json by the emotion radar runtime before persistence.

transcript_audio_id.description: Optional id of the underlying audio file (if the user opted to keep one). Audio bytes live OUTSIDE storage — files matching *.wav / *.mp3 are gitignored and the storage layer does not move them.

notes.description: Optional free-text user notes attached to this round (e.g. 'rehearsed for tomorrow's 1-on-1').

updated_at.description: ISO-8601 timestamp of the last write. Stamped by the storage layer on save when the caller omits it.
